CLINICAL PEARL — Baker's cyst
- **Gastrocnemius–semimembranosus bursa** → between medial head of gastrocnemius and semimembranosus
- Opens into joint via transverse **slit under medial gastrocnemius tendon** → open in flexion, closed in extension (Rauschning 1980)
- Adult cyst → look for the cause inside the joint → meniscus tear, OA (osteoarthritis)

PITFALL — ligament of Winslow
- **Ligament of Winslow = OPL** → from semimembranosus up and lateral to the lateral femoral condyle
- One handbook calls the **POL** "Winslow" → wrong → POL = posterior oblique ligament of the **medial** side

### Popliteal artery
- Starts → **adductor hiatus** · ends → lower border of **popliteus** → anterior tibial + tibioperoneal trunk
  [[FIG: Fig 7.36 · 7.10
- **Tethered** at both ends (hiatus + soleal arch) → stretched in **knee dislocation**
  - Rule → measure **ABI** (ankle–brachial index); <0.9 → CT angiography
- Behind the posterior tibia (TKA tibial cut level) → flexion does **not** move it away

### Anastomosis around the knee
- **9 arteries** → 2 from above + 4 genicular from the popliteal + 3 from below · middle genicular → cruciates, not the ring (Netter)
  [[FIG: Fig 7.37 · 7.10

| From | Artery | Course / point to say |
|---|---|---|
| **Above** | **Descending genicular** (femoral, in the adductor canal) | Articular branch → medial side; saphenous branch goes with the saphenous nerve |
| | **Descending branch of the lateral circumflex femoral** (profunda) | Down along vastus lateralis → lateral side |
| **Popliteal** | **Superior medial / lateral genicular** | Wind round the femur just above the condyles, deep to the hamstrings / biceps; **superior lateral genicular artery** → lateral release |
| | **Middle genicular** | Pierces the OPL → **cruciates + synovium**; not counted in the ring |
| | **Inferior medial genicular** | Below the medial condyle, **deep to the sMCL** |
| | **Inferior lateral genicular** | Along the **lateral joint line**, deep to the FCL (between the laminae of layer 3) |
| **Below** | **Anterior tibial recurrent** (anterior tibial) | Up through tibialis anterior → front of the knee |
| | **Posterior tibial recurrent** | Small, behind the popliteus |
| | **Circumflex fibular** | Round the fibular neck, with the CPN |

- Two planes → **superficial** (subcutaneous fascia, in front of patella + patellar tendon)
  - **Deep** (on bone and capsule, round the articular margins) · **patellar ring** between them
